summary: For legacy accounts without SCA, find the pool with `sudo subscription-manager list --available --all | grep -A 30 "Ansible Automation Platform"` and attach it with `subscription-manager attach --pool=<pool_id>` (never use MCT4022). If packages are missing or you see "Repositories disabled by configuration", list repos and enable `ansible-automation-platform-2.6-for-rhel-9-x86_64-rpms`.
questions: How do I attach the AAP subscription with subscription-manager?
Repositories disabled by configuration when installing AAP
How do I enable the AAP 2.6 RPM repository?
Can I use MCT4022 as a pool id?

answer_card.title: Attach subscription and enable the repo
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
sudo subscription-manager list --available --all | grep -A 30 "Ansible Automation Platform"
sudo subscription-manager attach --pool=<pool_id>   # not MCT4022
sudo subscription-manager repos --list | grep -i ansible-automation-platform
sudo subscription-manager repos --enable ansible-automation-platform-2.6-for-rhel-9-x86_64-rpms
```
Only needed for legacy accounts without SCA.
